title_zh: 确认学校演练的出口与引导分工

scenario.label_zh: 确认学校演练出口及临时引导安排
scenario.goal_zh: 依据学校演练图确认离开路线，并约定设置标牌引导行人绕开集合通道

context_zh: 学校工作人员在一次预定疏散演练前核对校方给出的图示。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: The drill map says we evacuate through the east gate. Is the west gate out of use?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: For this drill, yes. The east route takes every class to the marked assembly area.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: Parents sometimes wait by that gate. How will we keep the route clear?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: We will divert arriving visitors to reception through the side entrance.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: Shall I erect the temporary signs before the drill starts?

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Yes, at the two points marked on the map. I will stand by the gate and direct visitors.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: All right. I will put up the signs at those points and check with you before the first class comes out.
